Request reprint permissions here.The Brazilian presidential election, which kicks off with a first round of voting on October 4, gives citizens a choice between radically different visions of politics. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, known as Lula, the standard-bearer of the Latin American left, seeks a fourth presidential term against Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of Jair Bolsonaro, the hard-right former president who was sentenced to 27 years in prison for attempting to overturn the results of the previous presidential election.
